name: barrier-hop-still
label: Synthetic demo
alt: Two cross-sections of a made-up pair of sheets. Top: a trace in amber runs straight from its seed through a place where the two sheets touch and ends on the neighboring sheet. Bottom: the same trace after the contact barrier, the seed's side in teal, the part past the contact in coral, and magenta marks where the barrier was drawn.
caption: Synthetic demo: the contact barrier (kit switchfix barrier, AutoPipeline 0.1.9) on made-up sheets. A trace that ran through a contact onto the neighboring sheet is cut back to its seed's side. No scan data.
